API Documentation¶

1. Prepare data¶

prep.read_data()[source]¶

This fcn read a csv file: it can read test data, train data. :param location_str: file location of the csv file :type location_str: str

Returns:

data frame with data (e.g. train or test)

Return type:

df (dataframe)

prep.select_numerical()[source]¶

Selects only numerical columns from the DataFrame.

Parameters:

df (dataframe) – DataFrame from which numerical columns are to be selected.

Returns:

DataFrame containing only numerical columns.

prep.select_categorical()[source]¶

Selects only categorical columns from the DataFrame.

Parameters:

df (dataframe) – DataFrame from which categorical columns are to be selected.

Returns:

DataFrame containing only categorical columns.

prep.split_train_data()[source]¶

Estimates the house price depending on different inputs.

Parameters:

  • train – Train data.

  • test – Test data.

  • sample – Sales prices of test data.

Returns:

Returns a DataFrame that contains the estimated price, the real price of the test data houses, and the absolute and percentage differences of real value and estimated values.

prep.save_prep_data_2_prep()[source]¶

Takes a DataFrame and tne name. The df is separeted in x and y data and numercial and categorical values.

Parameters:

  • df – DataFrame from which categorical columns are to be selected.

  • name – ‘train’ or ‘test’

Returns:

no return values. Saves the DataFrame for train, test and the numerical and categorical information to ../data/prep

prep.save_col_name()[source]¶

Save numerical and categorical column names to separate text files.

Parameters:

  • numerical_cols (list of str) – List of numerical column names.

  • categorical_cols (list of str) – List of categorical column names.

  • name (str) – A name to append to the filenames for saving the columns.

Returns:

None

The function creates two text files:

  • ‘data/prep/numerical_cols_<name>.txt’ containing the numerical column names.

  • ‘data/prep/categorical_cols_<name>.txt’ containing the categorical column names.

Each column name is written on a new line in the respective file.

2. Train model¶

train.build_model_estimate_house_pricing()[source]¶

Builds the preprocessing pipeline and the model.

Parameters:

x (dataframe) – DataFrame containing the features.

Returns:

A pipeline with preprocessing and model.

Return type:

pipeline

train.fit_house_pricing_models()[source]¶

fits the house price depending on different inputs.

Parameters:

  • pipeline (sklearn pipeline) – build model for house price estimation.

  • x_train (dataframe) – input data to train/fit the model

  • y_train (dataframe) – output data to train/fit the model

Returns:

Returns a fitted model (pipeline) to estimated price,

train.estimation_test()[source]¶

test the fitted model :param pipeline: model for house price estimation. :type pipeline: sklearn pipeline :param df: test data :type df: dataframe :param target_str: variable to be estimated, “SalePrice” :type target_str: str

Return: no return data, just a model score value.

train.validate_estimation_house_pricing()[source]¶

Makes predictions and evaluates the model.

Parameters:

  • pipeline (sklearn pipeline) – The fitted pipeline.

  • X_valid (dataframe) – Validation features.

  • y_valid (dataframe) – Validation target variable.

Returns:

Predictions. mae: Mean Absolute Error. mape: Mean Absolute Percentage Error.

Return type:

preds
